'''Vetch''' was an [[Urodel]] [[Junk dealer|spare parts vendor]] whom the spare parts vendor [[Nurchi]] used to try and threaten the [[human]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] into repaying him a deposit in [[5 BBY]]. Nurchi confronted Andor in the streets of the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] while Vetch loomed behind Andor; however, Andor questioned why Vetch was working for Nurchi and then left.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Andor|I just asked you a question.|Vetch|What?|Andor|Since when do you take orders from Nurchi?|Nurchi|Don't answer that.|attr=Cassian Andor, Vetch, and Nurchi|audio=Vetch-Ordersogg.flac|src=<ref name="Andor1" />}}
[[File:Nurchi-Andor-Vetch-Andor1.png|thumb|right|300px|Vetch helped Nurchi confront Andor.]]
Vetch was an [[Urodel]] [[Junk dealer|spare parts vendor]]<ref name="Chrome" /> from [[Ferrix]],<ref name="Topps" /> a [[planet]] that he lived on during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He was familiar with the [[human]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]<ref name="Andor1" /> and sometimes worked for fellow spare parts vendor [[Nurchi]].<ref name="CGttSWG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> In [[5 BBY]], Nurchi planned to use Vetch for intimidation while trying to get back a deposit from Andor, telling the Urodel that all he needed to do was stand there. When Nurchi later spotted Andor rushing by his stall, the vendor confronted the debtor and prevented him from passing until Vetch moved up behind Andor,<ref name="Andor1" /> looming over him.<ref name="Andor1Audio">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>

Andor was surprised to see Vetch working for Nurchi and questioned the vendor on if he was trying to threaten him. He then questioned Vetch as to why he had started taking orders from Nurchi, asking if the Urodel was desperate for work.<ref name="Andor1" /> Shifting his wide-set [[eye]]stalks,<ref name="Andor1Audio" /> Vetch revealed that he had only been told to stand there, after which Nurchi again asserted that he wanted his [[Currency|money]]; however, Andor simply passed by him and left, stating that he would not mention the incident had taken place before saying farewell to Vetch. Nurchi then turned to stare at the Urodel, who questioned what was wrong.<ref name="Andor1" />

==Personality and traits==
Vetch was a massive,<ref name="Chrome" /> hulking Urodel with a big [[mouth]].<ref name="Andor1Audio" /> He was tall and stocky enough to intimidate anyone simply by looming over them, although he was generally friendly and gentle natured<ref name="CGttSWG" /> and did not seem interested in hurting anyone.<ref name="Chrome" /> He had [[Color|gray]] and pink skin.<ref name="Andor1" />

==Equipment==
Vetch wore a brown [[Clothing|jacket]] over a yellow and gray shirt with a brown [[belt]].<ref name="Andor1" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:VetchBTS-FerrixPt1.png|thumb|right|300px|Ian Whyte portrayed Vetch in ''Andor''.]]
Vetch was portrayed by [[Ian Whyte]] in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the first episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]],<ref name="Andor1" /> which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}}</ref> Among other roles in ''[[Star Wars]]'', Whyte previously portrayed [[Bollie Prindel]], the first Urodel character introduced in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="Celebration">{{SWYouTube|qV_dg8Citm4|The Creatures, Droids and Aliens of Star Wars: The Force Awakens | Star Wars Celebration Europe 2016}}</ref> Vetch was revealed prior to the release of the episode in the official promotional assets linked to the show released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Walt Disney Studios]] via [[Wikipedia:Getty Images|Getty Images]] on [[August 19]], 2022.<ref name="Getty">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/bgmfkwr42xhtqs4fpxw86v7r|text=The Walt Disney Studios All Access - PGM-FF-000276|date=2022-08-19}}</ref>
